{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-nm-x","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"d52b8956264f31735bd1c0f5f3595a903c9cbbfec08db485d75ea6cc4037f7b0","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-nm-class-std:lineage:28","source_registry_sha256":"22599efcb4852b796972acef6eb09f4cfe8d16ca15887f7ea7660c7748b4df92","source_liveness_sha256":"6766993f61347d495f390e08c7d8b1c44de597b6249cdb10686ea7f9f38e1ea3"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Speed control and parking restrictions","heading":"C2 — Speed control and parking restrictions","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — Speed control and parking restrictions

FACT_ID: sec07-R01 | anchor: A02
Parking inside an intersection is prohibited. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R02 | anchor: A02
Parking on a crosswalk or on a sidewalk is prohibited. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R03 | anchor: A02
Do not park in a construction zone when the vehicle would block traffic. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R04 | anchor: A02
The handbook prohibits parking within thirty feet of a traffic signal, stop sign or yield sign. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R05 | anchor: A02
The handbook prohibits parking within twenty-five feet of an intersection crosswalk. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R06 | anchor: A02
Keep parked vehicles at least fifteen feet from a fire hydrant. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R07 | anchor: A02
The handbook prohibits parking within fifty feet of a railroad crossing. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R08 | anchor: A02
A parked vehicle may not be more than eighteen inches from the curb. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R09 | anchor: A02
Do not park within twenty feet of a fire-station driveway on your side of the street. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R10 | anchor: A02
Do not park within seventy-five feet of a fire-station driveway across the street. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R11 | anchor: A02
Do not block a driveway, alley, private road or a lowered curb that provides sidewalk access. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R12 | anchor: A02
Parking on a bridge or overpass, or in a tunnel or underpass, is prohibited. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R13 | anchor: A02
Parking on the wrong side of a street is prohibited. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R14 | anchor: A02
A marked disability parking space requires an authorizing disability plate, tag or sticker. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R15 | anchor: A02
Do not park beside a vehicle that is already parked along the road, creating a second row. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R16 | anchor: A02
Parking on railroad tracks is prohibited. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec07-R17 | anchor: A03
Do not park where a sign prohibits parking. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec07-R18 | anchor: A03
A white-painted curb permits brief stops only. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec07-R19 | anchor: A03
A yellow-painted curb identifies loading or another specified restriction. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec07-R20 | anchor: A03
A red-painted curb marks a fire zone where neither parking nor standing is allowed. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec07-R21 | anchor: A03
A blue-painted curb identifies parking reserved for people with disabilities. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec07-R22 | anchor: A03
Common traffic violations can add points, with the number depending on the particular violation. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec07-R23 | anchor: A03
The handbook says accumulating twelve or more points in a twelve-month span produces a one-year driver-license suspension. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec07-R24 | anchor: A03
A list of point-bearing traffic offenses is available from the Motor Vehicle Division. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec07-R25 | anchor: A03
The handbook says driving without insurance requires a court appearance rather than traffic points. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec07-R26 | anchor: A03
The handbook says driving without vehicle registration requires a court appearance rather than traffic points. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec07-R27 | anchor: A03
A court appearance for the described nonpoint traffic offenses can lead to additional fines or a suspended license. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0017]
